decisions.reason: As a recent finish extension of the core drainage range, it preserves upside under still-unresolved market acceptance while adding only limited incremental commitment despite some SKU complexity.
This is a close-to-core shower channel aligned with modern seamless bathroom design, so the option value of staying in the market is likely higher than its carrying cost for now.

The pump-assisted solution is more technically complex and support-intensive than the other launches, but its niche potential in difficult installation settings is still uncertain enough to justify keeping it another year.
A tileable floor drain with grating fits directly into the firm's established barrier-free drainage business, making it cheap to carry relative to the value of learning about demand.
The design grate is a low-risk adjacent accessory that complements the existing portfolio, though the firm's broad range makes later pruning somewhat more plausible if demand proves thin.
